summary: Frontend-only mobile preview validation completed for the single-screen offline tone app.

react_native_issues.issue: Gallery, Camera, tone chips, reset, and camera controls do not expose testID/accessibility labels, making automated and assistive interaction brittle.

action_items: Add stable testID attributes to all buttons/chips, preview reset, camera close/shutter, loading/result states, and error text.
critical_code_review_comments: Offline analysis is correctly local: no fetch/API calls are used.
The UI uses React Native primitives and has no horizontal overflow at 390px.
expo preview log contains a non-blocking React Native DevTools Electron sandbox warning; Metro still bundles and serves successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 390x844, initial state, warm/neutral/cool manual results, gallery file chooser, local image loading (0-100%), analysis result, camera web preview, and no horizontal overflow passed. Reset was not directly automated because its Pressable has no stable selector.
rca_of_issue: Missing testID/accessibilityLabel props on Pressable controls in frontend/app/index.tsx prevents robust UI automation and assistive identification. Add identifiers without changing behavior, then rerun reset and camera-control checks.
